newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI plans news conference, report on April 15.
newsitem.headline: EMI plans news conference, report on April 15.

text.p: The European Monetary Institute (EMI) said on Thursday it would hold a news conference on April 15 to coincide with the release of its third annual report.

The Frankfurt-based institute, the forerunner to the European Central Bank, gave no further details on the contents of the report, which will be made available in all 11 European Union languages at the news conference.
The news conference is due to start at 1500 GMT.

In its first two reports, the EMI said lack of convergence on public finances in the EU area was the biggest obstacle to achieving a timely start for Europe's planned single currency, which is scheduled to begin in January 1999.
